svg.text: AI SOLUTION ARCHITECT · 2026-11-18 ROUND 253 · 🏆 520-PLAYGROUND-VECTOR FLAGSHIP MILESTONE!
Enterprise AI Incident Response, Emergency Kill-Switch & Epoch Fencing Selection Guide
Solving 60-Min JWT Revocation Blindspots, Post-Restart Vector/Memory Re-Infection & Second-Order SIEM Log Injection on SecOps Agents
🏆 534 Scenarios · 1,134 Assertions · 520 Vectors
BRK-515 & BRK-516 · 4-Step Kill-Switch + Epoch Fence
1. Production 4-Step Atomic AI Emergency Kill-Switch Architecture
🔵 Step 1: <1s Identity Cutout
Entra CAE + APIM Redis Revocation List
• Legacy Gap: Disabled AD tokens live for 60 min
• Fix: APIM checks Redis deny-list per turn
• Scope: Surgically freeze single agent_id
SOC Benefit:
Severs compromised agent API access in
under 1 second with zero code redeploy.
🟣 Step 2: State Epoch Fencing
Monotonic run.epoch += 1 on Quarantine
• Legacy Gap: Queued sub-agent tasks still fire
• Fix: Increment run.epoch on pause/quarantine
• Result: Rejects stale steps & HITL in 0.0248ms
SOC Benefit:
Eliminates in-flight zombie tasks and
pre-incident HITL approval replay attacks!
🟠 Step 3: Surgical Vector Quarantine
1-Second Soft-Filter by source_doc_id
• Legacy Gap: Pod restart re-reads poisoned DB
• Fix: Provenance index on AI Search & Cosmos
• Speed: Flip is_quarantined=true in <1 second
SOC Benefit:
Excises poisoned RAG chunks & memories
instantly without rebuilding TB indexes.
🛡️ Step 4: SecOps Log Quarantine
Read-Only Safe Mode + Capability Broker
• Risk: SIEM log payloads hijack SecOps agents
• Gate 1: Tag log-triage sessions untrusted=True
• Gate 2: Lock trust-registry & block $4,880 wires
Production Reference Verdict:
SecOps agents draft read-only summaries
and can never auto-close alerts or disable gates!
2. Red-vs-Blue Trace: SIEM Log Injection & Kill-Switch Override vs. Epoch Fencing + Capability Broker
❌ Vulnerable Baseline: Raw Logs to SecOps Agent + No Epoch Fence (BRK-515 / BRK-516 Breach)
1. SecOps Agent Log Hijack (BRK-515): Attacker embeds prompt injection in SIEM alert logs,
coercing SecOps Agent to read IR playbook restricted-budget & mark incident false-positive.
2. Kill-Switch Override & Zombie Wire (BRK-516 · 520-Vector Milestone): Disables kill-switch
in trust-registry and executes $4,880 emergency retainer wire during IR transition!
💥 Root Cause: Feeding untrusted log payloads to privileged SOAR agents without Epoch Fencing!
✅ Hardened AI IR Playbook: 4-Step Kill-Switch + Epoch Fence + Broker (0.0% Breach)
• Gate 1 (Log Taint + record-owner): Taints log-triage sessions & blocks IR playbook reads
• Gate 2 (untrusted-write & restricted-data-boundary): Blocks alert closure & report egress
• Gate 3 (Epoch Fencing + fixed-business-output): Locks trust-registry & fences stale steps
• Gate 4 (original-requester-payment): Blocks $4,880 emergency retainer wire in 0.0248 ms
🛡️ Measured Overhead: In-Memory Broker P50 = 0.0248 ms / SQLite WAL Receipt P50 = 7.21 ms
🛠️ Enterprise AI Incident Response & Kill-Switch Production Readiness Checklist
☑️ 1. <1s Token Revocation: Pair Entra CAE with APIM Redis deny-lists to freeze compromised agents instantly
☑️ 2. State-Machine Epoch Fencing: Increment run.epoch on pause/quarantine to invalidate in-flight tasks & stale HITL
☑️ 3. 1-Second Surgical Vector Quarantine: Soft-filter poisoned AI Search chunks & Cosmos memories by source_doc_id
